pumac-2022-algebra-a-07.title: Count how often each value occurs
pumac-2022-algebra-a-07.body:
$a_n=k$ iff $k\le\sqrt[3]n+\frac12<k+1$, i.e. $(k-\tfrac12)^3\le n<(k+\tfrac12)^3$. Expanding,
$$k^3-\tfrac32k^2+\tfrac34k-\tfrac18\ \le n<\ k^3+\tfrac32k^2+\tfrac34k+\tfrac18 .$$
The interval has length $3k^2+\frac14$. For a real $m=\lfloor m\rfloor+f$, the number of integers in $[m-(3k^2+\frac14),m)$ is $3k^2+1$ if $f\in(0,\frac14]$ and $3k^2$ otherwise. Here the right endpoint is $m=k^3+\frac32k^2+\frac34k+\frac18$, so $f=\frac18+\left\{\frac{6k^2+3k}{4}\right\}\in\{\frac18,\frac38,\frac58,\frac78\}$, and $f=\frac18$ exactly when $4\mid 3k(2k+1)$, i.e. when $4\mid k$.

So the number of $n$ with $a_n=k$ is $3k^2+1$ if $4\mid k$ and $3k^2$ otherwise.

**Sum.** $\mathcal F_N$ is the set of $n$ with $a_n\le N$, so
$$S_N=\sum_{k=1}^N\frac{3k^2+[4\mid k]}{k^2}=3N+\sum_{\substack{4\mid k\\k\le N}}\frac1{k^2}=3N+\frac1{16}\sum_{j=1}^{\lfloor N/4\rfloor}\frac1{j^2}.$$
Therefore $S_N-3N\to\frac1{16}\cdot\frac{\pi^2}6=\frac{\pi^2}{96}$ and $a+b=1+96=97$. (Numerically, for $N=400$ the difference is $0.1022$ versus $\pi^2/96\approx0.1028$.)

**Answer: 97**

pumac-2022-algebra-a-08.title: How f changes the recurrence
pumac-2022-algebra-a-08.body:
Suppose $a_0=0,a_1=1$ and $a_{n+2}=s\,a_{n+1}-p\,a_n$, with characteristic roots $\alpha,\beta$ ($\alpha+\beta=s$, $\alpha\beta=p$) and $a_n=c_1\alpha^n+c_2\beta^n$. Then by the binomial theorem
$$b_n=\sum_k\binom nk(c_1\alpha^k+c_2\beta^k)=c_1(1+\alpha)^n+c_2(1+\beta)^n,$$
so $\{b_n\}$ has characteristic roots $1+\alpha,1+\beta$: it satisfies $b_{n+2}=s'b_{n+1}-p'b_n$ with
$$s'=s+2,\qquad p'=(1+\alpha)(1+\beta)=1+s+p,$$
and $b_0=0$, $b_1=a_0+a_1=1$.

Fibonacci has $(s,p)=(1,-1)$. If $(s_k,p_k)$ denotes the pair after $k$ applications, then $s_k=2k+1$ and $p_{k+1}=1+s_k+p_k$ gives $p_k=k^2+k-1$, by induction: $p_{k+1}=1+s_k+p_k=1+(2k+1)+(k^2+k-1)=k^2+3k+1=(k+1)^2+(k+1)-1$.

For $k=2022$: $s\equiv45$, $p\equiv505\pmod{1000}$, so $c_{n+2}\equiv45c_{n+1}-505c_n$ with $c_0=0,c_1=1$:
$$c_2=45,\quad c_3\equiv45^2-505\equiv-408,\quad c_4\equiv45(-408)-505\cdot45\equiv-325,\quad c_5\equiv45(-325)-505(-408)\equiv775 .$$

**Answer: 775**
